title: Add Inquiry to Quotation conversion
description: Close the audited Inquiry usability gap by adding a direct Inquiry -> Quotation prefill/create action on the existing Quotation EF workflow. Reuse the current quotation from-inquiry mapping and add duplicate protection without production schema changes.
acceptance_criteria: Inquiry UI exposes a direct Convert/Create Quotation action.
Customer and inquiry detail values are mapped through the authoritative existing quotation from-inquiry rules and totals are revalidated server-side.
Invalid inquiry states are rejected and repeated conversion cannot silently create duplicate quotations.
Source inquiry traceability remains visible using existing fields/conventions without a production schema migration.
Unit/integration tests cover mapping, invalid state and duplicate protection; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Convert an inquiry to quotation and verify customer/detail mapping.
Repeat conversion and verify duplicate prevention.

human_gate.reason: Uses existing Inquiry/Quotation application schema and mapping.
